scope: Flow-owned documentation pattern contracts required by documentation templates.

decision.reason: The patterns close the public contract gap for documentation templates while preserving the rule that FlowDocs cannot own structural wrappers. React/runtime work remains blocked until components and audit gates are explicit.

governanceCoverage: documentation-page-shell owns shell/page background and grid overlay boundary.
documentation-hero owns docs hero hierarchy, metadata, actions, and governed background treatment.
documentation-section owns docs section surfaces, matrices, callouts, and grouped evidence.
demo-preview-frame owns demo, viewport, source, loading, and error frame boundaries.
on-this-page-nav owns local page section navigation and avoids Sidebar/Tabs duplication.
artifact-metadata-bar owns repeated artifact metadata without local pill wrappers.
nextRequiredWork: Create or explicitly defer supporting component contracts: Code Block and Copy Button.
Add audit gates that fail on local FlowDocs wrappers for shell, hero, section, demo frame, local navigation, metadata bars, raw pre/code, and copy buttons.
Then start documentation template runtime work in Flow before migrating FlowDocs adapters.
